end.summary:
Counted sides and corners of triangles, rectangles, squares, kites, and stars.
Used visible edges and meeting points to count sides and corners.
Identified a triangle even when it was tilted.
Corrected a square count from five to four sides.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides as line segments and corners as the points where lines meet. Ayaan explained that a rectangle has four sides and four corners, and used the same idea for tilted triangles; the square-count mix-up was corrected later by recounting carefully. At home, ask them to find three flat shapes and count their sides and corners aloud, including one turned or tilted shape.
